verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the agent can analyze requirements, implement features and write tests (codegen-docs-1, codegen-docs-29). They also cover the rest of the workflow: a structured implementation plan (codegen-docs-22), running and testing changes in isolated sandboxes (codegen-docs-5), and creating branches, commits and pull requests (codegen-docs-4, codegen-docs-24). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery, and in-depth docs on how the agent writes and validates tests beyond one-line claims.
